quick_english: Making the mind one-pointed there, with restrained mind, senses, and actions, sitting on a seat, one should practice yoga for self-purification; by steadiness of seat and time, mind-steadiness arises, and mind-actions and other sense-actions are led into restraint.
Holding body, head, and neck even and motionless, steady, looking at the tip of one's own nose, and not looking at the directions.

With calm self, fearless in the celibacy vow, established, having restrained the mind, mind fixed on me, joined, one should sit, devoted to me; holding with effort in looking at the nose tip, not looking at directions, with mind fixed on me, joined, one should sit, thus the meaning.

quick_english: Supreme happiness approaches the calm-minded yogi who has become brahman and stainless.
Thus uniting the self, the yogi with controlled mind attains ultimate union with brahman with ease.

quick_english: The yoga-united self sees the self abiding in all beings and all beings in the self; contemplating the self entering as knower unifies all beings, so equal seeing arises.
cite_parts: ātmani ca grāhyatājñānadvāreṇa sarvāṇi bhūtāni  ekīkuryāt
vistarastu bhedavādavidāraṇādiprakaraṇe  devīstotravivaraṇe na mayaiva nirṇītaḥ iti tata evāvadhāryaḥ

quick_english: Whoever sees me everywhere and sees all things in me is not lost to me, nor am I lost to him. Destruction comes from non-action. The all-pervading form of the supreme self flees from one who does not see it, since its own form is not manifested. All things are established in the supreme self, the self-illuminator. One who does not see this is lost from true nature, apart from true shining. But one who sees me all-pervading is not lost to me by my own form, through shining; and fears seen in me fit that shining when seership is complete, so such a one is not lost of the supreme self.

quick_english: By previous practice one is carried even unwilling; even one desiring to know yoga transcends word-Brahman. Indeed, even unwilling and dependent, by that previous practice alone one is forcibly led to yoga practice.
